# Columns: year, event, reference, Espenak-Meeus regression, JPL Horizons regression.
# reference: independent truth. The JPL Horizons geocentric Sun vector (LT+S), rotated at reception TT into the
#   mean IAU 2006 ecliptic of date with the true equinox (ERFA pnm06a, obl06, nut06a), interpolated to the
#   quarter-longitude crossing. This is the nominal reference for the seasonal roots.
# regression: what Seasons.forYear returns under each Delta T model. These
#   are engine output, not truth; they detect changes to the engine.
# Values are the shortest decimal strings that round-trip to the binary64 values.
